pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Interactive speaking.

2. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Thank you
   C. Good night
   D. Good day / hello

3. When practising Listening for information, Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information, Oral Expression.

4. When practising Active Listening Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening Interactive speaking.

5. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Haus
   C. Buch
   D. Wasser

6. When practising Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Extensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Extensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for information, Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Active Listening, Interactive speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for information, Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Active Listening, Interactive speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Speed Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Skimming for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for fluency, Scanning for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Skimming for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
